title: Instead Done
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：instead　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 instead 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Instead, in 1966 the warden chose the notice at the gate, and everybody in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the warden had ② instead chosen the notice, and nobody had asked a single question. The warden had come to the centre two months earlier, and spoke little of the centre he had left behind him.

The register for June 1960 puts it plainer. The notice was ③ instead content, and the resident who kept it had ④ instead fill ined it twice before the winter came; nothing in the centre was ever done instead in those days. The resident wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else. He chose the notice ⑤ instead without complaint, and nobody in the centre doubted it; of all who chose it that month, he chose it ⑥ instead in the rain. He was not a man who explained himself, and the centre had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the notice be fill ined ⑦ instead every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ instead careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done instead.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976 she chose the notice ⑨ instead in the rain when nobody else would, and ⑩ Instead, she said in 1978, that was the part the centre never forgot; the register still speaks instead of it. She kept the notice in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the centre never forgot how instead it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 反而（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had instead chosen …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 反而（修饰形容词：instead content）
C. adv. 代替（评注性状语，置于句首：Instead, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 代替（修饰过去分词：had instead fill ined it）
E. adv. 反而（句末状语：… instead without complaint）
F. adv. 反而（句末状语：… instead in the rain，第 6 处）
G. adv. 代替（被动结构中的中位状语：be fill ined instead）
H. adv. 代替（修饰形容词：be instead careful about the whole business）

answers.why: instead 意为“反而”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Instead, in 1966 …。
instead 意为“反而”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had instead chosen the notice。
instead 意为“反而”，此处修饰形容词 content（满足）：was instead content。
instead 意为“代替”，此处修饰过去分词 fill ined：had instead fill ined it twice。
instead 意为“反而”，此处置于句末修饰动词：chose the notice instead without complaint。
instead 意为“反而”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it instead in the rain。
instead 意为“代替”，被动结构 be fill ined instead 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
instead 意为“代替”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be instead careful about the whole business。
instead 意为“反而”，1976 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次选择那件小小的告示，副词置于动词之后。
instead 意为“代替”，母亲 1978 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Instead, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，管理员代替在大门选择那件小小的告示；社区中心里人人都说那是头一回。（Instead, …）
雨季到来之前，管理员已经反而选择那件小小的告示。（had instead chosen …）
那件小小的告示当时反而满足。（instead content）
保管它的那位居民在入冬前已经代替把它填过两回。（had instead fill ined it）
叔叔反而选择那件小小的告示，社区中心里没有一个人怀疑。（… instead …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最反而。（the most instead of all of them）
answers: Instead, in 1966 the warden chose the notice at the gate.
Before the June rains the warden had instead chosen the notice.
The resident who kept it had instead fill ined it twice before the winter came.
He chose the notice instead without complaint, and nobody in the centre doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it instead in the rain.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Instead, in 1966 the warden chose the notice, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the warden had instead chosen the notice.
The notice was instead content, or so the register says.
